what.text: This page follows refugees from Colombia living in Costa Rica, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 7193 Colombian refugees in Costa Rica, 9.0% of all refugees from Colombia.
Ecuador hosts the most Colombian refugees, followed by Venezuela, Canada and Costa Rica.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Colombia in every year from 1990 to 2025, with the FARC, ELN and EPL among the opponents.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2004 to 2014, fall within that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 34 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 16623, at the end of 2014.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Costa Rica.
These are year-end totals for Costa Rica only, reported to UNHCR.
